conventions: All public APIs use type hints
No circular imports between packages
core does not depend on cli, runtime, diagnostics, or ai
runtime does not depend on cli or diagnostics
diagnostics does not depend on cli
cli uses only public framework APIs
tests do not modify framework source
environment detection does not mutate the environment
configuration never prints secrets to output
Lifecycle state machine is deterministic and immutable per transition
Bootstrap is deterministic and repeatable
Config is immutable after finalisation
EnvironmentInfo is frozen (immutable)
RuntimeContext is not a global singleton
Exceptions carry code, component, stage, and cause fields
CLI exit code 0 means success, non-zero means error
All path handling uses pathlib, not hardcoded slashes
Windows is a first-class environment, not an afterthought
Generated metadata (.betrayer/manifest.json, .betrayer/architecture.json) is rebuilt with 'python -m betrayer manifest --write' and is never hand edited
Every CLI command is registered in COMMANDS, COMMAND_HELP and _COMMAND_HANDLERS in betrayer/cli/main.py
Validator and doctor report only real measurements or real imports, never guesses
Each module has one canonical role: api.py (façade), errors.py (exceptions), lifecycle.py (state machine) -> never both in one module
